Worker Dies After Hand Trapped in RBI Note-Shredding Machine in Kerala

A worker died after their hand became trapped in a note-shredding machine at an RBI office in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The incident occurred during the installation of the machine. Police have stated that the worker's hand got stuck in the equipment.
